title: Agent-written text renders as markdown wherever it lands, not only in the panel
description:
`apps/dashboard/src/panel/markdown.tsx` renders the subset of markdown an agent writes, and `Panel.tsx` is its only caller — so the brief reads properly and every other screen shows the source.

Move it to `apps/dashboard/src/markdown.tsx`: it stopped being the panel's the moment a second screen wanted it. Then use it everywhere an agent wrote the words: the decision question and each option's `reason` and `costLater` in `panel/Decision.tsx`, the same fields in the new decisions list, `because` on each match in `distribute/Distribution.tsx`, the scan findings and the rejection text in `review/Review.tsx`, and the node description wherever else it is printed.

Two places stay as they are, and the node says so rather than leaving a reviewer to wonder: `logs/Logs.tsx` is a monospace line-per-event transcript where a backtick is what the agent typed, and the CLI is a terminal with no renderer.

Keep the renderer's shape. It returns React elements and never an HTML string, and it has no links — which together are why there is no sanitiser to get wrong, and it ships to every user inside the CLI bundle (ADR 0007).
